bullets: Closed with numbers: 09:50 opening drive, laggard catch-up family (0 of 92), event-day gap-and-hold (0 of 12), quiet-top continuation long NH1, break-even exits (worse on 27 of 27 family-sides).
CWT14SKIP (skip CWT14 failed-break longs far below the open) passes its own bar (t 2.13) but loses on down days and adds +0.00026R/trade: a lead only.
Lab costs are heavier than live paper fills (0.218R vs ~0.06R per trade), so the bars are conservative; tight stops cost the most, which STOPW tests next.
Lesson: give-back counted from best excursions overstates any exit fix about 10x - break-even stops cut more winners than they save.
For the owner (FYI): the Setup Generator's screen does not rank live results, and none of its conditions is positive without its best day.
